## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [docs/AUTHORING.md](../docs/AUTHORING.md).
- [ ] `npm run generate` ran and the regenerated `registry.json` / `components/demo-index.tsx` are committed.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `meta.json` has a one-sentence description, dependencies and the search tags (`stops`, `mistakes`, `aliases`, `flows`, `fields`).
- [ ] Works with keyboard only and a screen reader; honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] Checked in light mode, dark mode and at 375px wide.
- [ ] No `window` / `document` / `localStorage` access at module scope or during render.
